purpose: Teach: 打倒/降伏/介在/適法/内在/剥奪/受刑/労働党

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯罪組織打倒の作戦を警察、進めてらっしゃいますね
lines.en: So the police are advancing operations to dismantle this criminal organization, correct?
lines.style: Measured curiosity, slightly formal. Soft upward inflection at the end—genuinely asking, not testing. Steady eye contact, thinking aloud with precision.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者が降伏する瞬間まで備えております
lines.en: Yes. We're prepared all the way through to the moment the suspect surrenders.
lines.style: Clipped, professional assurance. Slight emphasis on 「備えております」—the kind of preparedness that leaves nothing to chance. Calm authority, no need to elaborate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、第三者が介在した形跡を警察、確認されましたね
lines.en: And the police have confirmed traces of third-party involvement in this case?
lines.style: Quiet precision. Each phrase lands separately—not rushing. Seeking confirmation of a detail he suspects matters. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、適法な手続きで捜査を進めます
lines.en: We're conducting the investigation within proper legal procedures.
lines.style: Formal reassurance. Deliberate enunciation of 「適法」—emphasizing legitimacy. Steady, no apology in the tone. This is how it's done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者に内在するストレス要因も警察、考慮されてますね
lines.en: The police are also taking into account the underlying stress factors affecting the victims?
lines.style: Gentle but direct inquiry. Thoughtful pause before the question—he's shifted focus to the human dimension. Warm respect for Takeda's consideration.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正資産の剥奪手続を進めます
lines.en: We're moving forward with procedures to seize and forfeit the illegal assets.
lines.style: Concrete pivot. Faster tempo than before—action items. Confidence in the procedural steps. Clinical but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、受刑者の社会復帰支援を警察、ご相談されてますね
lines.en: And you're consulting on support programs for offenders' reintegration into society?
lines.style: Reflective, approving. Softer delivery—he's acknowledging the longer view. Slight warmth in recognizing Takeda's thoroughness beyond the immediate case.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、労働党所属議員からのご質問にも対応します
lines.en: We're also responding to inquiries from members of the Labour Party.
lines.style: Closing statement, slightly widened scope. Brief, efficient. A small acknowledgment of the bigger machinery at work. Composed finality.
